Your voice. Your research. Your craft.

A focused sanctuary for your manuscript.
Precision in rhythm, clarity in craft.

Hear where a chapter breathes or stalls. Dim the narration to isolate dialogue and hear if your characters sound alike. Trace every scene detail and historical fact back to its source, and share clean reading copies—all inside a private, offline studio built for authors.

Meet Lixity ↓ Try a passage in browser →

Fictional English manuscript. Interactive read-only demo. No account or upload required.

From first draft to finished scene.

Close reading, research notes, and chapter comparisons stay anchored to your words. Everything runs privately on your computer; optional speech and research tools are set up separately.

Ready in v0.8.0: full offline prose analysis, Direct Speech Mode, manuscript reader, research dossiers, and standalone reading copies—plus the built-in editor in the current release.

Distraction-free writing. Grounded close reading.

Read in clean typography, drop review markers where a line catches, and check sentence cadence in context. The built-in editor pairs calm drafting with automatic local saves, conflict protection, and full undo history—so drafting and revision stay in one place.

Editor scope and availability (English)

Hear the pulse and voices of your prose.

Catch glue-heavy sentences that slow pacing, test whether characters speak differently from the narrator, and spot indirect speech, repeated words, or abrupt POV and scene shifts. Every signal highlights the exact words on the page—100% offline, with optional genre ranges and zero AI rewriting.

Text-analysis workflow (English)

Research with memory and proof.

Link manuscript passages straight to primary sources, character dossiers, and story decisions. Saved snapshots preserve the evidence behind every detail—keeping historical facts, places, and motives consistent across drafts.

Take a short tour

Clean reading copies and print proofs.

Create crisp book PDFs, standalone offline companion sites, or focused proof copies for beta readers and editors. No cloud accounts, no lock-in: your manuscript stays completely yours.

Reading copy (English)
“

Insight without interference: the author leads.

Lixity holds up a clear mirror to your prose, never a rulebook. It never grades your writing or rewrites a single line with AI. You see the exact words behind every pattern and decide what belongs in your voice.

Bring your own manuscript.

Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Open any Markdown or plain-text draft by following the setup guide.

Installation guide (English)
uv tool install --python 3.12 --managed-python lixity

Install v0.8.0 locally in seconds. Optional speech and research tools stay strictly separate and under your control.

Website measurement (English)

This public website uses GoatCounter to count page visits and named demo, installation, repository and PDF links. The adapter sends public page paths and event names, excluding query strings, fragments, form contents and manuscript selections. The local app and exported manuscript reports contain no such measurement.

Language and appearance choices are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. Browser language is used only to suggest a public introduction; it is not sent to a translation service or used to change manuscript analysis.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable collection. Counts are approximate and do not establish installations or active authors. GoatCounter receives technical request data; see its privacy information. For questions, use the contact below.
